**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Show billed tokens on failed usage rows**

When a streamed `response.incomplete` or `response.failed` includes usage, these nonzero values are saved on a row that still has `metadata["error"]`; `LlmUsage#failed?` therefore remains true, and the Settings LLM Usage table at `app/views/settings/llm_usages/show.html.erb:131-151` renders only “Failed” in the Tokens column instead of the newly recorded counts. Those tokens are nevertheless included in the summary totals and the row's cost is shown, so users cannot see or reconcile which failed call consumed the billed tokens; render the counts alongside the failure status.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Use `UsageCost.calculate` for failed-call cost, as the successful path does.** The failed-call branch estimates cost with `LlmUsage.calculate_cost` and never reads the usage `cost` field. When a failed stream reports a cost on an official OpenRouter endpoint, the stored `estimated_cost` is a token-based estimate. A reported `0` is stored as a positive estimate. The successful-call branch avoids this by calling `UsageCost.calculate`, which returns the reported cost when one is present and falls back to token estimates otherwise. Use the same call in the failed branch. Non-OpenRouter calls without a reported cost keep the existing token-based estimate. This change also applies the Anthropic cache-read split to failed calls, as the successful path already does.
Suggested fix

```diff --- "a/app/models/provider/openai.rb" +++ "b/app/models/provider/openai.rb" @@ -870,9 +870,9 @@ # Tokens are counted when the failed call still reported usage (e.g. response.incomplete) prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens = usage ? extract_token_counts(usage) : [ 0, 0, 0 ] estimated_cost = if usage - LlmUsage.calculate_cost(model: model, prompt_tokens: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens: completion_tokens) + UsageCost.calculate(model: model, usage: usage, uri_base: client.uri_base) end inferred_provider = LlmUsage.infer_provider(model) family.llm_usages.create!( ```
Add a failed-stream test. Its usage should include `cost: 0` on the official OpenRouter URI. The test should assert that `estimated_cost` is `0`.
Committable suggestion

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion UsageCost.calculate(model: model, usage: usage, uri_base: client.uri_base) ```
